snippet.title: Tremor - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A 32 level excursion through a parallel version of Quake, an attempt to evoke the Quake atmospheres of old through the vessel of modern design tools and philosophies. 
Featuring the mapping efforts of Ionous, Skacky, onetruepurple, Miss Bubbles, Cardo, Zothique, Kell, Fairweather, negke, Newhouse and Chris Holden. Music by AlekswithaK. Coding by Khreathor. Console image by Biff_Debris. 

Download it here:
https://www.slipseer.com/index.php?resources/tremor.614/download
